title: System + Interfaces largest bucket depth pass (SYS-09/SYS-10/SYS-16/IF-13)
acceptance_criteria: DNS settings support system name-server and system domain-search ownership through GUI and backend validation.
System Update Check and System Watchdog have dedicated form-first pages backed by scoped backend wrappers.
Sidebar/navigation includes new System pages and smoke probes cover their routes.
Wireless interface editor supports additional VHT capabilities from VyOS guide and saves via structured controls.
Backend and frontend validation commands pass for touched files.
System local user workflows cover principal and OTP authentication controls with backend validation and form-based UI.
Global system login settings (banners/session limits/RADIUS/TACACS) are manageable from GUI with validated backend contract.
assumptions: System update-check parity in this slice targets documented `system update-check url` support.
Watchdog parity in this slice targets documented `ping`, `startup-delay`, and `test-interval` controls.

tasks.notes: Added and registered thin config-tree wrappers for system update-check and watchdog.
Extended DNS model + update flow for system name-server/domain-search ownership and validation, with regression tests.
Added system resolver defaults fields to DNS tab and payload wiring/validation.
Implemented two new system pages and integrated navigation/help coverage.
Expanded wireless form/API model to include VHT capability depth (scalar, tag, and beamform flag leaves).
Extended wrapper tests and smoke route probes; backend/frontend validation commands passed.

Live triage for user-reported Not Found: confirmed system wrapper endpoints exist (401 unauth), runtime smoke passed after vm-api/vm-ui restart; browser smoke remains blocked by missing Playwright OS dependency.
Extended SYS-16 parity depth: update-check now supports auto-check toggle; watchdog now supports enable/module/timeout/shutdown-timeout/reboot-timeout plus existing optional ping/timer controls.
Validated with frontend TypeScript check, production build, and runtime smoke; restarted vm-ui to ensure new UI is served.
Extended local-user API/model/parse and write operations for principal + OTP controls (key/rate-limit/window-size) with regression coverage.
Extended System Users create/edit/inventory UI to manage principal + OTP controls with client-side numeric validation and clear semantics.
Added /vyos/system/login-config GET/PUT with parser + diff-based apply for banners/session limits/radius/tacacs and regression coverage.
Added Global Login Authentication form section to System Users page with RADIUS/TACACS server row editing and session/banner controls.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_system_login_config.py tests/test_system_local_users_parity.py tests/test_system_services_ssh_dns.py tests/test_config_tree_wrapper_capabilities.py && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s lint && npm run -s build && npm run -s smoke:runtime && npm run -s smoke:ui
